skill.name: daily-routine-note-move-tasks
skill.description: Move unchecked tasks from yesterday's routine note into today's (day-start carry-forward).

skill:
task today,yesterday,move,carry,forward,unchecked
carry forward,carry-over,move unchecked,unchecked tasks
- From yesterday's note, extract only unchecked task lines matching `- [ ] ...`. - Ignore checked tasks (`- [x]`), headings, events, notes, and placeholder text. - If yesterday's note is missing or has no unchecked tasks, proceed with an empty carry-forward list.
### Move unchecked tasks into today's note 0. Call `read_file` on today's path and `read_file` on yesterday's path. If today's note is missing, create a new note with the same template as yesterday's note. 1. Call `write_file` with `overwrite` to add carried-forward tasks from ``. Keep the source note unchanged and do not duplicate a task already present in today's note.
